resources.string: Allows FocusLock to send blocked apps back to the home screen and to detect adult websites opened in browsers. Only acts on apps you blocked or on adult URLs.
If you remove this device administrator, you will be able to uninstall FocusLock. Your focus session and blocked-app protection depend on it. Think carefully.
Activate the device administrator so FocusLock can help protect you from uninstalling it during a weak moment.
Typing challenge — prove this is really what you want. Type the 200 characters below, exactly as shown, perfectly, with no errors. Any single mistake keeps the removal locked. There is no skip.
Continue — unlocks only with a perfect match
Perfect match. Tap to allow deactivation.
Wait 2 hours instead of unlocking now
Persistent countdown notification shown while a deactivation attempt is being held
FocusLock protection stays on. A permanent wait is running because a deactivation or uninstall was attempted.
